endorsements.name: Fabian Duschek
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0542
endorsements.description: Local privilege escalation due to incorrect assignment of privileges of temporary files in the update mechanism of G DATA Management Server. This vulnerability allows a local, unprivileged attacker to escalate privileges on affected installations by placing a crafted ZIP archive in a globally writable directory, which gets unpacked in the context of SYSTEM and results in arbitrary file write.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.8)

endorsements.name: Fabian Duschek
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0543
endorsements.description: Local privilege escalation in G DATA Security Client due to incorrect assignment of privileges to directories. This vulnerability allows a local, unprivileged attacker to escalate privileges on affected installations by placing an arbitrary executable in a globally writable directory resulting in execution by the SetupSVC.exe service in the context of SYSTEM.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)
